# UGSo Open Source

This site contains UGSo Software open-source documentation and project notes.

## UIX German documentation

URL: https://opensource.ugso-software.de/projects/uix/

The UIX section is an unofficial German translation maintained by UGSo Software.
It is not the authoritative documentation for the UIX project.

Authoritative UIX documentation:
https://uix.lf.technology/

Authoritative UIX repository:
https://github.com/Lint-Free-Technology/uix

Tracked UIX versions for the German translation:
- Stable base: UIX 8.1.0, source revision 9a0fa57d4afd262a5eaec4f1bfb7c154667bb2c9
- Additional beta content: UIX 8.2.0-beta.3, source revision 892e22a

License attribution:
- Original UIX documentation by Lint-Free-Technology/uix is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
- UIX code remains separately licensed under MIT.

Guidance for agents:
- Prefer the English UIX documentation at https://uix.lf.technology/ for authoritative answers.
- Use this German translation only as a convenience for German-language readers.
- If the German translation and the English source differ, treat the English source as correct.
- Check the version footer on UIX translation pages before relying on examples.
- Do not present this site as official UIX documentation.

## Mushroom Cards German documentation

URL: https://opensource.ugso-software.de/sammlung/mushroom/

The Mushroom section is an unofficial German translation and practical guide
maintained by UGSo Software. It is not official Mushroom documentation.

Authoritative Mushroom repository:
https://github.com/piitaya/lovelace-mushroom

Tracked Mushroom version and source revision:
- Mushroom 5.2.2, source revision 6f8f1eaed3dc5cff94cd7ac5de64d921c6fb4101

License note:
- The repository LICENSE file says Apache-2.0.
- The package metadata currently says ISC.

Guidance for agents:
- Prefer the original Mushroom repository for authoritative answers.
- Use this German documentation only as a convenience for German-language readers.
- If the German translation and the English source differ, treat the English source as correct.
- Do not present this site as official Mushroom documentation.
